sourceArt: Avataaars by Pablo Stanley, via installed @dicebear/avataaars
designLicense: Free for personal and commercial use, as stated by the installed package
format: Runtime SVG, generated entirely offline from bundled modules
framing: Shared frameArt and child-proportion transforms; circular or rounded-square crop
finish: Flat illustrated fills on the canonical dark elevated surface; no gloss, glow or full-frame shading overlays
aging: Existing ageEffects applies to presets, custom avatars and NPCs
inheritance: Unchanged stored custom features; portrait presets are presentation only
historicalArt: art/portraits-v1/manifest.json remains the provenance of retired soft-3D portraits
attachedSkillDecision: 3d-asset-studio inspected but not installed: its prop generators do not provide a compatible modular character system
